verdict.rationale: The first-party manual says you press + and provide a repository URL, and that Working Copy supports the https, ssh, git and http protocols. It adds SSH key identities (imported, generated, or held in the Secure Enclave) and provider integrations that list your repositories for one-tap cloning. A community report shows the app syncing a GitHub-hosted repo, but that is not corroboration of cloning over each protocol. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on evidence of cloning over SSH and the git:// protocol.
